sloka: इक्ष्वाकुसचिचश्चायं नावसीदितुमर्हति ।तथा मया विधातव्यं विश्रमेत यथा कपिः ॥५-१-९०॥
transliteration: ikṣvākusacicaścāyaṁ nāvasīditumarhati ।tathā mayā vidhātavyaṁ viśrameta yathā kapiḥ ॥5-1-90॥

translations.english: 'I will have to make arrangements for his rest. Later he can resume his journey comfortably'.
